title: Double Drip 10k Prefilled Pod Vape Kit
description: The Double Drip 10K Pod Device is a high-performance, low-maintenance vape kit designed to deliver exceptional MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with long-lasting flavour and no messy refills. Featuring a built-in 1100mAh battery and a refillable 2ml pod that is easily refreshed with a 10ml refill bottle, both containing premium 20mg nic salt e-liquid, this smart and compact device offers extended vaping with minimal effort. Each kit comes prefilled with one of ten popular flavours, and is easily recharged via USB-C. The auto-refill mechanism ensures that the pod draws from the 10ml refill as you vape, providing up to 10,000 puffs from a single setup. The pod's integrated mesh coil enhances flavour and vapour production, while Boost Mode delivers three times the power for a more intense vape whenever you want it. The sleek, metallic body feels great in the hand and is paired with a crisp LED digital display that shows puff count and battery life at a glance. Designed for use with Double Drip 2ml pod + 10ml refill replacement packs, the Double Drip 10K combines smooth, satisfying performance with unrivalled convenience, offering a distinctive new format for enjoying the bold, flavourful Double Drip experience. Read our complete Double Drip 10K vape guide for everything you need to know. How to Set Up: Remove all silicone bungs and protective stickers from the device before use.
